turns.q: My order arrived and one item is damaged, what do I do?
turns.replyTail:
· AI says:

A damaged item? Annoying, but fixable! Contact Love, Bonito promptly via the contact form, within 30 days of delivery, including:

Your order reference
The damaged item’s product code
A photo of the item or defect

Customer Care will review your case and respond as soon as possible. Depending on the situation, they may offer a replacement, refund, or another solution. If it’s out of stock, store credit or a refund may be issued.
